Everything you need. Nothing you don't.

  • Stays in, all day

    Ergonomic shape that sits securely in your ear, so the earbuds stay put on runs, commutes and long calls.

  • Big, rich sound

    11 mm dynamic drivers tuned for deep bass and clear vocals, at up to 110 dB.

  • Hybrid adaptive ANC

    Up to 40 dB of noise reduction that adapts to your surroundings, plus Transparency mode when you want to hear the world.

  • 6 mics, clear calls

    Three microphones in each earbud, with environmental noise cancellation that keeps your voice clear on calls.

  • Fast charge

    0 to 60% in 20 minutes, 80% in 30 minutes. Up to 9 hours per charge and 45 hours with the case (ANC off).

  • Two finishes, made to impress

    Navy or Black with brushed-silver caps, in a giftable branded box.

FAQ

Good questions.

When will my order ship?

Shipping starts December 15, in time for Christmas. You'll get a tracking email as soon as your order ships.

When am I charged?

$5 today to reserve. The rest of your tier price, minus any referral credits, is charged when your order ships.

Can I cancel?

Yes, anytime before your order ships. Your $5 deposit is refunded in full.

Can I change my color?

Yes, switch between Navy and Black anytime before shipping by replying to your order email.

How does the invite reward work?

Share your personal link. Each friend who reserves and completes their purchase takes $10 off your balance, up to 3 friends ($30).

What if my tier sells out during checkout?

Your price is locked when your $5 deposit goes through. If the tier fills before that, you'll see the next tier's price before you pay.

What's covered by the warranty?

Defects in materials and workmanship for 1 year from delivery. We repair or replace the earbuds.

What if my order arrives damaged?

Contact us and we'll send a replacement or issue a full refund, your choice.

How do returns work?

You have 30 days from delivery to return your earbuds for a full refund, with free return shipping.

Do they work with iPhone and Android?

Yes. They connect to any Bluetooth device, including iPhone, Android, tablets and laptops.

Will they stay in during workouts?

Yes. The ergonomic shape sits securely in the ear, and IPX5 protects against sweat and splashes.

Will Artix Pro be on Amazon?

Yes, after launch at $149.99. Presale prices are available only on this site, only during presale.
